topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Rain's been falling all day, streets slick like a snake's back. Got a call from this old buddy, voice all tight, telling me about his friend. Says he found out the guy's been spinning yarns about where he's been working. I took a drag on my cigarette, looked out the window at the city lights shimmering in the puddles. "People get scared, they do things," I said, low and steady. "Maybe your friend's just trying to keep afloat in this storm." I could hear him on the other end, breathing in the silence. "Sometimes, the truth's buried deep, and you gotta dig with a gentle hand," I added, thinking about how this world can chew a man up. "Take it easy, don't jump to no conclusions just yet."
